name: Authentik
description:
## Install Information

*Initial Install May take a bit to start up!*

To start the initial setup, navigate to https://<your server's IP or hostname>:9443/if/flow/initial-setup/.

There you are prompted to set a password for the akadmin user (the default user).

## What is authentik?

authentik is an open-source Identity Provider that emphasizes flexibility and versatility. It can be seamlessly integrated into existing environments to support new protocols. authentik is also a great solution for implementing sign-up, recovery, and other similar features in your application, saving you the hassle of dealing with them.

## Docs

Visit the [documentation](https://goauthentik.io/docs/) for more information

compose:
services:
  authentik-1:
    image: ghcr.io/goauthentik/server:2026.8.5
    command: server
    ports:
      - 9443:9443/tcp
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/authentik-media:/media
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/authentik-custom-templates:/templates
    environment:
      - AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__HOST=authentik-db
      - AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__USER=authentik
      - AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__NAME=authentik
      - AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__PASSWORD=${AUTHENTIK_DB_PASSWORD}
      - AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY=${AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY}
    depends_on:
      - authentik-db
    x-runtipi:
      internal_port: 9000
      is_main: true
  authentik-worker:
    image: ghcr.io/goauthentik/server:2026.8.5
    command: worker
    user: root
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/authentik-media:/media
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/authentik-certs:/certs
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/authentik-custom-templates:/templates
    environment:
      - AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__HOST=authentik-db
      - AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__USER=authentik
      - AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__NAME=authentik
      - AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__PASSWORD=${AUTHENTIK_DB_PASSWORD}
      - AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY=${AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY}
    depends_on:
      - authentik-db
  authentik-db:
    image: postgres:18-alpine
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${AUTHENTIK_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_USER=authentik
      - POSTGRES_DB=authentik
    healthcheck:
      test: pg_isready -d $${POSTGRES_DB} -U $${POSTGRES_USER}
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 20s
x-runtipi:
  schema_version: 2
